chunks.title: Climate Investment Funds (CIF / Clean Technology Fund) (CIF / CTF) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Climate Investment Funds (CIF / Clean Technology Fund) is a Multilateral Climate Fund headquartered in United States (Multilateral). At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Co-host of Climate Funds Pavilion; launched $94M AMPLIFi clean electrification finance; seeded $250M CTF into Türkiye TIDIP. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: $94M AMPLIFi catalytic finance (mobilizing $1.2B+) + $250M CTF seed for Türkiye $6B TIDIP + $47M Brazil forest restoration. Source verification: https://www.downtoearth.org.in/climate-change/cop31-starts-a-new-era-of-electrification.

chunks.title: CIF / CTF Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Climate Investment Funds (CIF / Clean Technology Fund) provides the following climate financing instruments: Catalytic Concessional Loan, First-Loss Guarantee, Grant, Blended Finance (via MDBs). Typical transaction ticket range is USD 10,000,000 to USD 250,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Sovereign/Government, Large Corporate, Project SPV, Financial Intermediary.

chunks.title: CIF / CTF Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Climate Investment Funds (CIF / Clean Technology Fund): Electrification & Grid, Industrial Decarbonization, Renewable Energy, Energy Storage, Nature-Based Solutions & Forestry, Coal Transition. Target geographic focus includes: Developing Countries, Emerging Markets, Türkiye, Africa, Asia, Latin America. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: CIF / CTF Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete CIF / CTF's application form: Channeling through an implementing MDB (World Bank, IFC, EBRD, ADB, AfDB, IDB); Country Investment Plan endorsement (e.g., TIDIP / AMPLIFi / ACT); High private-sector capital mobilization ratio (typically >5x); Verified GHG abatement & transformational impact metrics. Explicit exclusion rules: Direct non-MDB applications; Coal expansion. Official application portal: https://www.cif.org/.

chunks.title: CIF / CTF Form Template: UNFCCC / Multilateral Climate Fund Concept Note & Funding Proposal
chunks.text: Climate Investment Funds (CIF / Clean Technology Fund) uses the 'UNFCCC / Multilateral Climate Fund Concept Note & Funding Proposal' workflow governed by GCF Investment Framework / GEF-9 / CIF AMPLIFi / Adaptation Fund Direct Access Standards. Typical review timeline is 3–9 months (Concept Note -> Accredited Entity Review -> Board Decision). Form sections required: 1. Proposal Overview, 2. Country Ownership, 3. Financial Structuring, 4. Investment Criteria, 5. Safeguards & Inclusion, 6. Governance & Sustainability, 7. Executive Summary.
